items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:27:1
items.html: BON, being the sorts of the seven Melachim with the Achoraim de AVI. Meaning from AA downward, as well as in the lower seven de Atik. However, GAR de Atik do not have any Achoraim de Keter in them, much less of ZAT de Nekudim.
